column3: NKJV has “seventy,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “seventy-two.”
Close to the Greek; “miracles” is rendered “mighty works.”
NKJV has “who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has a question, “Will you be exalted to heaven? You will go down to Hades.”
NKJV has “seventy,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “seventy-two.”
NKJV has the present “I give,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has the perfect “I have given.”
NKJV names “Jesus” and has “in the Spirit,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “He rejoiced in the Holy Spirit.” “I fully consent to You” is rendered “I thank You.”
Close to the Greek; “robbers” is rendered “thieves.”
